get.description: Report whether the API is up and can reach the database

post.description: Sign up with an invite code; logs the new user in

get.description: The logged-in user and the session's CSRF token

post.description: Log in. A wrong username and a wrong password get the same response

get.description: The user's unexpired sessions, most recently used first

delete.description: Log a device out. For the current session, this is the same as `DELETE /api/session`

patch.description: Change the display name or weight unit; fields left out stay as they are
Change the password and log out every other device; this one stays logged in

get.description: Library exercises and the user's own, ordered by name

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Part of the name, any case
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Part of the name, any case

post.description:
Add a custom exercise. 409 `duplicate_name` if the user already has one with this name,
ignoring case; sharing a library exercise's name is fine

patch.description: Change one of the user's exercises; 403 `read_only` for library exercises

delete.description:
Delete one of the user's exercises. 409 `exercise_in_use` if a workout or set record
uses it; 403 `read_only` for library exercises

get.description: Library routines and the user's own, ordered by name

post.description: Create an empty routine owned by the user, starting at cycle 1

get.description: The whole routine: its workouts with their exercises and sets, and its cycle of slots

patch.description:
Rename one of the user's routines or change its description; 403 `read_only` for
library routines

delete.description:
Delete one of the user's routines, with its workouts and sets. Exercises and recorded
sets stay; 403 `read_only` for library routines

post.description:
Copy a library routine or one of the user's own into a new routine the user owns:
its workouts, their exercises and sets, and its cycle of slots, keeping every position.
Exercises are referenced, not copied

get.description: The routine's cycle, in position order

post.description:
Add one of the routine's workouts to its cycle, at the end or at `position`, shifting
later slots. 422 unless the workout is in this routine

put.description: Set the order of all the routine's slots at once; returns them in the new order

patch.description: Put a different one of the routine's workouts in the slot, or move it with `position`

delete.description: Take the slot out of the cycle; later slots move up. The workout itself stays

get.description: The routine's workouts, in the order they were added

post.description: Add a workout to the routine. It isn't in the cycle until a slot points at it

delete.description:
Delete the workout with its exercises and sets, and take its slots out of the cycle;
the remaining slots close up

get.description: The workout's exercises in position order

post.description:
Add an exercise at the end, or at `position`. 422 unless it's a library exercise or
one of the user's own

put.description: Set the order of all the workout's exercises at once; returns them in the new order

patch.description: Swap in a different exercise (keeping the sets), or move it with `position`

delete.description: Delete it with its sets; later exercises move up

post.description: Add a set at the end, or at `position`, shifting later ones

get.description:
Suggested values for the next set: a copy of the last set's targets, or just the user's
preferred unit for the first set

put.description: Set the order of all the sets at once; returns them in the new order

patch.description: Change the targets or unit, or move the set with `position`

delete.description: Delete the set; later sets move up

get.description:
The user's history of the exercise: newest session first, then each session's records
in order. Times are the sessions' `performed_at`. Page back by passing the last record's
`performed_at` as `before`. A page runs past `limit` when needed so records with the
same time are never split across pages. `total` counts every match

parameters.name: before

schema.description: The `performed_at` of the last record already shown; pages back
schema.title: Before

parameters.description: The `performed_at` of the last record already shown; pages back

get.description:
Suggested values for logging the exercise: the given set's targets, else the user's
latest record of it, else just their preferred unit

parameters.name: set_id

schema.description: A prescribed set of this exercise to start from
schema.title: Set Id

parameters.description: A prescribed set of this exercise to start from

put.description:
Log a set under a client-generated id, or replace the record with that id: 201 when
created, 200 when replaced, so the same request can be retried safely. 409 `id_conflict`
if the id is another user's record. The session must be the user's own (404), and the
exercise a library one or the user's own, and `set_id` a set in the session's workout
(422)

delete.description: Delete the record; later records in its session move up

put.description:
Create a session under a client-generated id (201), or change the one with that id
(200). On an existing session only the fields sent change, so the same request can be
retried safely. 409 `id_conflict` if the id is another user's session

patch.description: Back-date the session, or mark it completed

get.description: The session's records in position order

put.description: Set the order of all the session's records at once; returns them in the new order

post.description:
Start the next cycle of one of the user's routines. Each prescribed set takes the
weight and unit of the latest record linked to it from a completed session in the
current cycle; planned reps stay, unlinked records are history only, and sets with no
record keep their targets. Then the current cycle closes and the next one opens
